verdict: IMPROVE V2 (improve_v2.py): four evidence-motivated improvements A/B'd against the multimodal_stack baseline (0.489+/-0.011 specific recall@50, oracle 0.622), same splits, 3 seeds. RESULTS: I1_simweight +0.001, I2_rankfusion -0.004, I3_agreegate -0.011, I5_simfusion +0.003, ALL -0.023. NONE of the recall levers clears a real margin (>+0.005 on >=2/3 seeds): similarity-weighting, rank fusion, agreement-gating and similarity-level fusion all land within seed noise of the baseline. This is the ceiling_cartography prediction confirmed at the engineering level -- the retrieval channels are bounded by WHICH knockouts exist to retrieve, not by how their outputs are combined. THE REAL GAIN IS I4, A NEW CAPABILITY, NOT A RECALL BUMP: a sign head predicts the DIRECTION of change on 96% of correctly-retrieved movers vs 50% coin-flip, 67% global-majority-class, and -- THE DECISIVE CONTROL -- 92% for a PER-GENE direction prior (each gene's usual direction, learned from train KOs, needing no knockout-specific information). Head and per-gene prior disagree on 10% of hits; where they disagree the head is right 69% -- so the head carries genuine KNOCKOUT-SPECIFIC direction beyond each gene's own habit. The model can now say up-or-down, which it previously could not do at all. READING: recall is saturated for this model class on this data, exactly as the ceiling work predicted; the productive direction is adding CAPABILITIES (direction, calibrated abstention) rather than chasing recall points. Deterministic; hyper-params tuned on validation only.
